title: Adjournment speech on deeper Singapore-Malaysia economic integration and the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone
what_it_is: An adjournment motion debate in which MP Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat set out proposals for deeper economic integration with Malaysia and Southeast Asia, followed by a response from Minister of State for Trade and Industry Alvin Tan, before Parliament adjourned.
why_it_matters: The transcript says the Johor Bahru-Singapore Rapid Transit System Link will arrive in 2027 carrying up to 10,000 passengers an hour each way, and cites a DBS estimate that $1.5 billion to $2.1 billion a year of retail spending could leak to Johor, with food and personal services hit hardest. It records that Singapore and Malaysia have jointly agreed to attract 50 projects in the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone in five years and 100 in 10 years, and that Singapore and Singapore-based companies have committed over $5.5 billion in investments into Johor since a January 2024 Memorandum of Understanding.

key_points.point: Southeast Asia is described as about 680 million people and a US$4 trillion economy, with median ages in Malaysia and Indonesia around 31, Vietnam 34, the Philippines 27, against Singapore citizens' median of nearly 44.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: Southeast Asia is about 680 million people and a US$4 trillion economy.

key_points.point: He said the region has perhaps 15 to 20 years to get rich before it grows old.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: The region has perhaps 15 to 20 years to get rich before it grows old.

key_points.point: He said ASEAN trades with itself only about a fifth as much as it trades with the world, 21% against the European Union's 60%.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: still trades with itself only about a fifth as much as it trades with the world – 21%, against the European Union's 60%

key_points.point: He said about three-quarters of Singapore's exports depend on external demand.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: about three-quarters of our exports depend on external demand

key_points.point: He called for deeper, more structural integration with Southeast Asia.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: We must build a deeper, more structural integration with Southeast Asia.

key_points.point: On the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone, he said nine flagship areas have been announced at the level of districts and that he has not seen a consolidated boundary map.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: Nine flagship areas have been announced, described at the level of districts; I have not seen a consolidated boundary map.

key_points.point: He said Malaysia's New Incentive Framework took effect for manufacturing on 1 March, and asked what a Singapore company receives inside the zone over and above that federal baseline.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: Malaysia's New Incentive Framework took effect for manufacturing on 1 March.

key_points.point: He proposed sorting out with Malaysian counterparts one standard operating procedure to enter the zone and one rulebook.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: we should soon sort out, with our Malaysian counterparts, one standard operating procedure to enter the zone and one rulebook

key_points.point: He proposed that EDB or MTI be responsible for total KPIs over the zone, not just Singapore-originated investments alone.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: EDB or the Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) should be responsible for total key performance indicators (KPIs) over the JS-SEZ, not just the Singapore-originated investments alone.

key_points.point: He said Malaysia's National Semiconductor Strategy puts indigenous IC design at the centre, with RM25 billion behind it and a 60,000-engineer training goal.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: Its National Semiconductor Strategy puts indigenous IC design – about half of a chip's value-added – at the centre, with RM25 billion behind it and a 60,000-engineer training goal.

key_points.point: He proposed allowing Research, Innovation and Enterprise funds to lease or rent Singapore-based fab lines so real silicon can be put in front of the region's designers.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: we should allow Research, Innovation and Enterprise (RIE) funds to lease or rent Singapore-based fab lines so that we can put real silicon in front of the region's designers

key_points.point: He proposed that NTU and NUS set up an embedded institute in the Selangor cluster carrying a joint credential.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: our universities, the Nanyang Technological University and National University of Singapore, should seek to set up an embedded institute in the Selangor cluster carrying a joint credential

key_points.point: He proposed recognising in law a Malaysia-Singapore business entity defined by a minimum stake on each side, such as 30-30, 40-40 or 50-50.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: we should recognise in law a Malaysia-Singapore business entity, defined by a minimum stake on each side – 30-30, 40-40, 50-50

key_points.point: He proposed reactivating the Malaysia-Singapore Business Development Fund.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: we should reactivate the Malaysia-Singapore Business Development Fund

key_points.point: He said integration will arrive as a train in 2027, with up to 10,000 passengers an hour each way.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: Integration will arrive as a train in 2027, up to 10,000 passengers an hour each way.

key_points.point: He cited a DBS estimate that retail leakage to Johor is $1.5 billion to $2.1 billion a year, 3% to 4% of retail sales.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: DBS puts the leakage at $1.5 to $2.1 billion a year – 3% to 4% of retail sales

key_points.point: He proposed that Singapore take an equity stake in some of the transit-oriented developments the RTS line creates.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: Singapore should take an equity stake in some of these transit-oriented developments the line creates

key_points.point: He proposed a tradeable entitlement for on the order of 40,000 small retailers who rent rather than own their premises.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: on the order of 40,000 provision shops, eateries, personal-care operators and so on – a tradeable entitlement

key_points.point: He said the entitlement should go to the tenant and not the owner of the unit.
key_points.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
key_points.quote: It should go to the tenant and not the owner of the unit

key_points.point: He framed the key question as how to ensure deeper integration with the region, including Malaysia, is additive and not substitutive.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: how do we ensure deeper integration with the region and in fact, not just ASEAN but Malaysia which is additive and not substitutive?

key_points.point: He said the zone spans about 3,500 square kilometres and includes the Iskandar Development Region and Pengerang.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: It spans about 3,500 square kilometres, it includes Iskandar Development Region and Pengerang.

key_points.point: He said the boundaries of the zone are available online.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: the boundaries of the JS-SEZ are available online

key_points.point: He said Singapore has a joint JS-SEZ Project Office helping Singapore and Singapore-based companies explore twinning opportunities in the zone.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: In Singapore, we also have a joint JS-SEZ Project Office, which helps Singapore and Singapore-based companies explore twinning opportunities in the JS-SEZ.

key_points.point: He said the refreshed Johor-Singapore Cooperation Ministerial Committee, co-chaired by Minister Chee Hong Tat and Malaysian Minister for Economy Akmal Nasrullah, will provide strategic oversight for broader cooperation including the SEZ.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: The refreshed Johor-Singapore Cooperation Ministerial Committee, co-chaired by Minister Chee Hong Tat and Malaysian Minister for Economy Akmal Nasrullah, will also provide strategic oversight for broader cooperation including the SEZ.

key_points.point: He said Singapore accounts for one out of five in every semiconductor equipment manufacturing and one out of 10 semiconductor chips.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: We account for one out of five in every semiconductor equipment manufacturing and one out of 10 of semiconductor chips.

key_points.point: He cited STMicroelectronics, which anchored its Asia Pacific HQ and wafer fab operations in Singapore, complemented by assembly and test operations including high reliability automotive packaging in Johor.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: STMicroelectronics which anchored its Asia Pacific HQ and wafer fab operations in Singapore, complemented by assembly and test operations, including high reliability automotive packaging in Johor.

key_points.point: He said Singapore and Malaysia have jointly agreed to attract 50 projects in five years and 100 projects in 10 years.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Singapore and Malaysia have jointly agreed to attract 50 projects in five years and 100 projects in 10 years.

key_points.point: He said Johor recorded its highest ever approved investments last year, with over 70% attributed to the zone.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Last year, Johor recorded its highest ever approved investments, with over 70% of those investments attributed to the zone.

key_points.point: He said that since the January 2024 Memorandum of Understanding, Singapore and Singapore-based companies have committed over $5.5 billion in investments into Johor.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Singapore and Singapore-based companies have committed over $5.5 billion in investments into Johor.

key_points.point: He said the RTS Link Taskforce, which he chairs, has been engaging residents, merchants, trade associations and landlords, and that findings and recommendations will be shared later this year.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: We will be sharing our findings and recommendations later this year.

key_points.point: On the Member's suggestions about different deals with the Malaysians, he said it is within their jurisdiction.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: On his suggestions about different deals with the Malaysians, I think it is within their jurisdiction.

key_points.point: He said the test is whether Singapore remains where the highest value functions are anchored, where important decisions are made, where capabilities can be built and where good jobs for Singaporeans can be created.
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: whether Singapore remains where the highest value functions are anchored, where important decisions are made, where we can build capabilities and where we ultimately can create good jobs for Singaporeans

what_happens_next: Mr Alvin Tan said the RTS Link Taskforce will share its findings and recommendations later this year. The transcript records that Parliament was adjourned accordingly at 7.23 pm.
not_said: Whether a consolidated boundary map of the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone will be published
What a Singapore company receives inside the zone over and above Malaysia's federal incentives
Whether the Malaysia-Singapore Business Development Fund will be given a new purpose
Whether a Malaysia-Singapore business entity will be recognised in law
What measures the RTS Link Taskforce will recommend and when they would take effect
Whether Singapore will take equity stakes in transit-oriented developments in Johor
How a tradeable entitlement for small retailers would be funded and administered
